item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/APPLE_2017_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
for i,t in enumerate(data.get('texts',[])):
    txt=t.get('text') or ''
    if re.search(r'incorporat|Employer Identification Number|EIN|Delaware|California|IRS', txt, re.I):
        print('IDX', i, 'PAGE', t.get('page_no'), 'LABEL', t.get('label'))
        print(txt[:500].replace('\\n',' '))
        print('---')
PY"

import json,re

        print('IDX', i, 'PAGE', t.get('page_no'), 'LABEL', t.get('label'))
        print(txt[:500].replace('\\n',' '))
        print('---')
PY"
